prompt.structure:
[Instrumental]
[Intro: 3 bars, pad and soft pluck]
[Verse: 7 bars, light beat comes in]
[Pre-Chorus: 6 bars, fuller]
[Chorus: 6 bars, full energy, the lift]
[Break: 9 bars, settle back, keep the groove]
[Verse: 8 bars, playful, leave space]
[Build: 8 bars, rising]

prompt.notes: Ask for about 1:40. Suno won't hit these lengths exactly: drop the track on the music lane and use Line up, which puts its biggest lift on 'Claude makes it' and corrects its tempo.
